title: hymenocallis dryanderi
intro: Hymenocallis dryanderi, commonly known as the Yellow Trumpet Lily or Swamp Lily, is a flowering plant species native to the southeastern United States. This plant is known for its fragrant, trumpet-shaped flowers and is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Hymenocallis dryanderi include reducing fever, relieving coughs and colds, and treating skin conditions. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
